title: the eyes wake on the 49 hit, blink on the clap
story: Fergalicious at 129 BPM opens with one strong hit at 35 (onset 49.1), and the oracle's eye snaps open from closed lids while the pupil contracts. For the intro the eye glances aside and then locks on the viewer at the boundary 125, where the drums come in. The drum grid follows the bar: kick slots 1 and 9 dilate the pupil, claps on slots 5 and 13 blink hard, the strong e-sixteenths pop the eye's size, and each 2 bars the eye count steps 2, 4, 2, 4, 2 with a hue swing, the flashes at 609 and 644 bursting every eye at once. The post-roll settles back to two eyes on the bar grid.
